name: AA Live Your Site
author: AA Extensions

sections.description:
A lightweight WordPress plugin that safely updates all site URLs in your database after migrating from localhost to a live server or changing to a new domain.

Features

  1. Update all site URLs across WordPress database tables
  2. Safe Mode: Preview changes without modifying data
  3. Backup database before URL update (requires server support)
  4. Support for Elementor and other page builders
  5. Works with multilingual and multi-language sites
  6. Option to include custom tables for premium users
  7. Elegant and user-friendly admin interface
  8. Built-in Help and Troubleshooting tabs
  9. Collapsible FAQ section within the settings page
  10. Secure with nonce verification and permission checks

How to use it

  1. Enter the old URL you want to replace (e.g., `https://oldsite.com`).
  2. Enter the new URL to update to (e.g., `https://newsite.com`).
  3. Optionally, check “Create database backup” to save your current database.
  4. Optionally, enable “Safe Mode” to preview changes without applying them.
  5. Optionally, check “Include custom tables” to update additional plugin data (premium feature).
  6. Click “Update URLs” to start the replacement process.
  7. Review the success or preview messages displayed after the operation.

Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin and choose the ZIP file.
  5. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  6. Access the plugin from the admin menu labeled Live Site.
